No local tmux session appears tied to this task (the 'stt' session predates step 8's start_time by ~2 hours and is a pre-existing leftover). Cannot rule out that an `az ml compute start` (or equivalent) call was actually issued to one of the shared reserved machines in project/azure_vm.json before the process died -- this cannot be confirmed or denied without SSH access to the specific host, which was never recorded anywhere on disk.
